60€ fine incurred for riding transit without a ticket in Berlin

2024
NFT, digital scan

An NFT of a 60€ fine issued by the BVG, Berlin’s transit company, for riding without a ticket. Once the receipt was minted as a digital artwork and listed on SuperRare, the fine became a deductible business expense under German income tax law (Einkommensteuergesetz). The work satirizes both the NFT market’s readiness to commodify anything and the absurdities of tax law, turning a bureaucratic penalty into a conceptual artwork that pays for itself. It was shown at Dubai Design Week 2024, where it found a buyer.
